paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relative change across different categorical layer groupings for various token multiplier and bit-precision configurations. The categorical x-axis lacks a general label but displays discrete layer intervals from left to right: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis represents "Relative Change" on a linear scale, with values ranging from -25% to 5% and labeled tick marks at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The plot contains five distinct lines. The "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" is represented by a grey dashed line with no markers, which remains steady at exactly 0% across all x-axis intervals. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" line is a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 0% at Layer1-4, shows a minor decline to roughly -1.5% at Layer13-20, and slightly increases to end at roughly 0.5% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" line is a solid red line with square markers, starting at 0% at Layer1-4, dipping to approximately -4.5% at Layer13-20, and recovering to roughly -0.5% by Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" line is a solid light blue line with circular markers that begins at roughly -1.5% at Layer1-4, experiences a noticeable drop to approximately -12.5% at Layer13-20, and rises back to end at near -1.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" line is a solid dark blue line with square markers; it starts at approximately -2.5% at Layer1-4, undergoes a sharp decline to a minimum value of exactly -25% at Layer13-20, and steeply ascends to end at roughly -3% at Layer29-32.
